thesis: This episode argues that major consumer tech giants like Google and Meta are operating in the advertising industry with significant capital, but have not succeeded in healthcare despite heavy investment. It also suggests that these companies are web-native and built on different rails than Microsoft, with marketing budgets that are 10 times smaller than the healthcare industry.
